articles.title: Parrish vs. Crombie: As mayors past and present battle, will the drama drive voters to the polls?
articles.summary: In Mississauga, incumbent Mayor Carolyn Parrish is facing former mayor Bonnie Crombie. With a crowded field and a high-profile showdown at the top of the ticket, the central question hanging over the campaign is whether the drama will actually get residents to the polls.

articles.title: Grocery-style food bank aims to meet rising demand in Durham Region
articles.summary: Food bank visits in Durham Region have surged since the pandemic, according to Feed the Need Durham. The organization is turning to a grocery-style model it says can help make better use of food while giving people more choice. CBC’s Rochelle Raveendran has more.
